_comment: Per-school verification ledger for the sweeper (see EXPLORER-SWEEPER-SPEC.md §3 and .claude/skills/sweeper/SKILL.md). seedConfidence/seedGateType are a snapshot from uniData at scaffold time (2026-07-24) for prioritization convenience only — the sweeper must re-read live uniData for current confidence/gateType at run time, never trust these as current. 2026-07-27 entries are from a special full-coverage application-timeline audit (opens/closes only, not the full field set) — see sweeper/reports/2026-07-27-timeline-audit.md.

openFindings: closes was wrong: recorded '28 September 2026' (VTAC undergrad date) but Melbourne MD is graduate-entry via GEMSAS, not VTAC — real close is 29 May 2026, 5pm AEST (North Western Pathway extension to 8 Jun). Open date not confirmed against a primary source.
closes refined from 'TBC December 2026' to two confirmed windows: 13 Dec 2026 (assessment day 1) / 10 Jan 2027 (assessment day 2). Opens ~8 Apr 2026 (general UAC portal, not Sydney-specific).
closes confirmed: 30 September 2026 (was 'TBC'). Opens ~8 Apr 2026 general UAC, not UNSW-specific — estimated only.
closes 30 Sep 2026 confirmed matches (direct-application deadline is also 30 Sep 2026, no gap). Opens ~8 Apr 2026 general UAC, estimated.
Both opens (8 April 2026) and closes (30 September 2026) confirmed directly on WSU's own page — best-sourced record in this batch.
Opens 3 Aug 2026 9am, closes 28 Sep 2026 5pm — both confirmed on official VTAC key-dates page, matches existing closes value exactly.

closes confirmed: 30 September 2026 (was 'TBC'). Opens ~4 Aug 2026 general QTAC. Note: individual QTAC course-listing page for this program still shows a stale '2025' closing date — trust the key-dates page instead.
closes 30 Sep 2026 confirmed matches. Opens ~3 Aug 2026 general SATAC, not Adelaide-specific.
closes confirmed: 30 September 2026, 11:59pm (was 'TBC'). Opens 2 June 2026. Note: 'Direct Pathway' has been renamed 'Assured Pathway' by UWA — same course, naming update only.
Opens 2 June 2026, closes 30 September 2026 11:59pm — both confirmed on official TISC calendar, matches existing closes value.
closes 30 Dec 2026 confirmed matches exactly. Opens ~4 Aug 2026 general QTAC, no Griffith-specific override found. No interview stage/separate deadline.

closes was outdated ('early Feb') — real close for the May 2027 intake is 19 January 2027, 11:45pm QLD time (applications still routed through QTAC despite Bond being private). Open date not found/not published the same way as QTAC's general date.

closes confirmed: 30 September 2026, 11:59pm AEST (was 'TBC'). Opens 4 August 2026. Requires dual submission — both QTAC and a separate JCU Application Portal form, same due date. Rural Access Scheme sub-track closes 1 day earlier (29 Sep 2026).

officialUrl was stale (old URL 404s, corrected here). closes confirmed: 1 December 2026 (was 'TBC') — notably later than most other SATAC medicine programs, worth a sanity re-check next cycle. Opens ~3 Aug 2026 general SATAC.

closes (30 Nov 2026 UAC route) structurally matches existing value but was NOT re-quoted fresh this session — page returned no populated 2027-specific date text. Direct-ANU deadline ('8 May 2026, closed') also not re-confirmed — only prior-year (2025) pattern found. Internal Pathway-to-Medicine deadline (~30 places) still unconfirmed against a primary source, carried over from 2026-07-25 check.

SCHEMA MISMATCH, not just a date gap: both Sydney and Fremantle Notre Dame Medicine campuses are GEMSAS graduate-entry, not TISC/UAC/Direct as currently modeled at all. TISC's own Notre Dame info page does not list Medicine as TISC-applicable. Estimated GEMSAS window ~1 May–29 May 2026 (5pm AEST) sourced from a third-party admissions guide, not yet cross-checked directly against gemsas.edu.au for Notre Dame specifically — treat as estimated pending that check. gateType/portal fields likely need correcting, not just closes/opens.

officialUrl is DEAD (M3N course page 404s) — UTAS has restructured to course code H7X 'Bachelor of Medical Science and Doctor of Medicine', replacing the old M3N/MBBS-style structure. Dates otherwise confirmed correct for the new code: opens 1 Aug 2026, closes 30 Sep 2026 11:59pm AEST (matches existing 'late September' close). URL needs updating before next check.

University of the Sunshine Coast has formally renamed to UniSC — officialUrl 301-redirects, works but should be updated to the unisc.edu.au domain. closes confirmed: 30 December 2026 (was 'TBC'). Opens ~4 Aug 2026 general QTAC. No interview-based selection for this program.

sourcesChecked: https://www.latrobe.edu.au/courses/bachelor-of-biomedical-science-medical (via Firecrawl — WebFetch could not reach latrobe.edu.au)
openFindings: Opens 3 Aug 2026, closes 6 Nov 2026 noon AEDT (first Friday in November) — confirmed, matches existing closes value exactly. Interviews primarily early Dec, backup early Jan.

closes 25 Sep 2026 confirmed via UAC, matches existing value. Opens ~1 Jun 2026 but sourced only from a third-party blog — CSU's own application-dates page returned HTTP 403 and could not be independently confirmed; treat open date as estimated only.

officialUrl (wclsc1) 404s. Two distinct SATAC course codes exist and it's unresolved which one the app record should track: WCSCI1 'Bachelor of Clinical Sciences' (closes 1 Dec 2026) vs SMED01 'Bachelor of Clinical Science Medicine/Doctor of Medicine' (closes 9 Oct 2026 — closer match to the existing 'October' hint on file). Opens ~3 Aug 2026 general SATAC either way. Kevin needs to confirm which course the app intends before this can be marked verified.
Opens 4 Aug 2026, closes 30 Sep 2026 — both confirmed on CQU's own page, matches existing closes value. Separate MMI stage 24-26 Nov 2026 for shortlisted (UCAT-ranked) applicants.

closes 1 Jul 2026 re-confirmed (applies to both First-Year and Graduate Entry — Auckland lists them under one shared MBChB deadline, no separate Graduate Entry row exists). Opens date not found — no MBChB-specific open date published anywhere on Auckland's official pages; general apply-to-study portal is open year-round.

officialUrl was stale (404, corrected here). Two distinct stages exist and the existing 'closes 10 Dec 2026' is real but potentially misleading: 10 Dec 2026 is only the Health Sciences First Year (HSFY) enrolment deadline (opens 1 May 2026). The actual binding cutoff for Medicine 2nd-year selection (from HSFY) is 13 August 2026 (opens 1 Jul 2026) — 10 Dec doesn't guarantee a medicine place. Recommend recording both stages distinctly.
